title: De Novo Design of Nurr1 Agonists via Fragment-Augmented Generative Deep Learning in Low-Data Regime.
summary: A ligand-fine-tuned neural generator prioritized structurally novel Nurr1 agonists with measured potency and binding affinity. Early chemical leads, without animal or clinical efficacy.
organization: University of Perugia; Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München; University Medical Center Utrecht

evidence.tested: A ligand-fine-tuned neural generator prioritized structurally novel Nurr1 agonists with measured potency and binding affinity. Early chemical leads, without animal or clinical efficacy.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Fragment-augmented generative chemical language model is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
